releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Fix bottom face rendering of partial faces (crafting CPU, cables, QN Bridge) by @andrewsf in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8980
* Updated Crowdin Translations by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8446
* (26.1.2) Use IBlockExtension#getCloneItemStack instead of new ItemStack(Block) by @Frinn38 in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8716
* Fix Tooltips crashing for extremely large byte amounts by @shartte in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8991
* Remove neighbor updates from the Condenser caused by changes in the internal power level by @shartte in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8992
* Fix issue where crafting CPUs could act as-if they had infinite Co-Processors for a tick by @HaphLife in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8789
* Fix fluid rendering in recipes in JEI by @Mithi83 in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8902
* Fix items being moved out of a crafting grid not being considered for the new recipe by @shartte in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8993
* Refresh crafting CPU list once per second instead of every tick by @JoelCranston in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8989
* Allow only storage cells as input to ME IO Port by @Mithi83 in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8974
* Improve various user-facing English text (Guide, GUI, Advancement name) by @andrewsf in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8932
* Update "example Main Network" guidebook entry: cabling (#8947) by @andrewsf in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8948
* Add a suspend icon in CPUs selection list of crafting status screen by @Godox in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8744
* Fix spatial transitions when pylons and I/O ports are in different dimensions. by @shartte in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8994
* Add JMH benchmark infrastructure for storage code paths by @ghshhf in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8964
* Automatic pattern restock by @Satherov in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8873
* Avoid map allocation in VariantCounter for small key counts by @ghshhf in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8965
* Add MEStorage#getEstimatedStackCount to pre-size KeyCounter by @ghshhf in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8966
* Fix GUI Pick Block: support both mouse button and keyboard bindings by @andrewsf in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8976
